# v0.9.0 upgrade fixture

`v090-populated.json` was generated by running the source at commit
`d9ec11b3f8cb2f222381b15583b6842070106939` in an isolated temporary directory,
using Python 3.12 and the project's installed dependencies. It is not a schema
constructed from the new release.

The generator used `LocalRAG` with a fake three-dimensional embedding provider,
a text file, a DOCX with interleaved headings/table/paragraphs, and the existing
`tests.helpers.write_text_pdf` fixture. It indexed the files, applied an OCR
review correction through `correct_review`, attached evidence-backed metadata
and a relationship, then embedded pending corrected chunks. It exported the
original four MIGRATIONS, authoritative table rows, FTS contents and artifacts.
All runtime paths are replaced by `@FIXTURE@`.

The upgrade test reconstructs the populated old schema from those migrations
and rows before starting the new service. It compares every original column of
documents, chunks, vectors, reviews, review revisions, metadata and relationships,
checks BLOB backfill and Vietnamese retrieval, and reruns migration for idempotence.
No real account, user document or remote embedding provider was used.
